checks.name: focus round trip preserves original selection

candidate highlight is separate from current identity

source draft is retained after opening candidate
session list scroll reaches beyond one viewport
clicking a title opens its real session and pauses the previous one
clicking metadata opens its real session and pauses the previous one
narrow layout hides sidebar until requested
narrow sidebar and resizing leave runtime and model count unchanged
